# Sviatoslav Foshchii

> Technical project manager based in Copenhagen, working in Salesforce Marketing
> Cloud, Adobe Campaign and wider martech delivery. Focused on platform
> migrations, marketing operations continuity, and running delivery so that
> business-as-usual work does not break while systems change underneath it.

Personal site. Static, no tracking. Contact: sviatoslav@foshchii.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://foshchii.com/): Overview — who he is, what he works on, and how to get in touch.
- [About](https://foshchii.com/about.html): The long version, told as an interview: from a small Ukrainian town to Copenhagen, and the careers in between.
- [Experience](https://foshchii.com/experience.html): Roles, selected work, stack, credentials and languages — the full professional record.
- [Education](https://foshchii.com/education.html): Degrees, project-management training, and the Salesforce, Scrum and PM credential stack.
- [Writing](https://foshchii.com/writing.html): Index of field notes on martech delivery, platform migrations, CRM operations and AI-assisted work.
- [Contact](https://foshchii.com/contact.html): Booking calendar and direct email.

## Writing

- [Like for like is not a scope](https://foshchii.com/writing-like-for-like.html): Rebuilding exactly what exists imports every workaround the old platform forced on you, and promotes them to requirements.
- [Preview is not a test](https://foshchii.com/writing-preview-is-not-a-test.html): A preview tells you the template rendered. It says nothing about whether the journey fires or the right person receives it.
- [The data model decides](https://foshchii.com/writing-data-model.html): Schema choices made in week three determine which campaigns are possible in year two. Strategy decisions wearing technical clothes.
- [Consent is a record, not a checkbox](https://foshchii.com/writing-consent-records.html): What has to migrate alongside subscriber status — consent timestamps, source, wording, suppression lists and preference promises.
- [The inbox does not migrate with you](https://foshchii.com/writing-email-deliverability.html): Changing email platform resets sending reputation — authentication, warm-up, and the deliverability signals worth watching.
- [The migration nobody wanted](https://foshchii.com/writing-sfmc-migration.html): Adobe Campaign to Salesforce Marketing Cloud — protecting marketing continuity through a platform migration.
- [Keeping marketing operations running](https://foshchii.com/writing-marketing-operations.html): Why business-as-usual work deserves to be a first-class workstream during a migration, not an afterthought.
- [AI as a delivery partner](https://foshchii.com/writing-ai-delivery-partner.html): Where AI genuinely helps in delivery work, and where human judgment still has to win.
- [Vision](https://foshchii.com/writing-vision.html): What he believes about martech delivery, and how he works in it.
